products.name: Vellum
products.note: Personal AI assistant; on-device Mac app or cloud; cross-app memory; privacy-first design

profile_text.body:
Vellum describes itself as a personal AI assistant designed to "know you deeply" and evolve alongside the user, with an emphasis on privacy and individual ownership. The product runs either as an on-device Mac application or through the cloud, and it incorporates a memory system intended to reflect the way a person naturally remembers things. Users can configure the assistant's personality and supply their own context to shape how it behaves, distinguishing it from what the company characterizes as generic AI.

Vellum offers free credits to new users and passes model provider costs through at cost with no markup. Additional usage is available via pre-paid credits, and paid plans start at $30 per month, adding a larger compute environment, more storage, and bundled credits. The product is tracked in the Enterprise AI Platforms and Agent Orchestration category, with cross-app memory noted as a feature alongside its privacy-first design.

No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for this company.
